| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `list_api_resources` | Discover the API resources served by the cluster (core group plus named API groups). Optionally filter to a single group. Returns [{group, version, resource, kind, namespaced}]. |
| `get_resource` | Get a single resource by apiVersion (e.g. "v1" or "apps/v1"), plural resource, and name. Omit namespace for a cluster-scoped resource or to span all namespaces; provide it to scope to one namespace. Secret/ConfigMap values and container env values are redacted. |
| `list_resources` | List resources of a kind by apiVersion and plural resource, with optional label/field selectors. Omit namespace for a cluster-scoped resource or to span all namespaces; provide it to scope to one namespace. Secret/ConfigMap values and container env values are redacted per item. |
| `get_pod_logs` | Read a pod container log (bounded to the last 64KiB). Defaults to the last 200 lines; set previous:true for the prior container instance after a crash. |
| `list_events` | List recent events, defaulting to Warning type. Namespace-scoped when a namespace is set, else cluster-wide. |
| `top_nodes` | Node CPU/memory usage from the metrics API. Unavailable if metrics-server is absent. |
| `top_pods` | Pod CPU/memory usage from the metrics API. Omit namespace to span all namespaces; provide it to scope to one namespace. Unavailable if metrics-server is absent. |
